## Checklist

- [ ] It sticks to the styling of the app (existing components, colours from the CSS variables in `src/styles.css`, nothing that looks like a different app). See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] No new hard-coded colours, fonts, UI libraries or inline styles. (A new colour is added as a variable in both light and dark.)
- [ ] I checked light mode, dark mode and phone width. Screenshots are below.
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` pass.
- [ ] If this touches a page that search engines read (`/`, `/games`, a game page, a creators page) or its data: I compared `curl` of the page with the page in a browser. Same words, games, order, counts, links, headings, title, canonical and robots tags. Nothing is shown to Google only. The matching `startng-be` PR is linked here.
